what: Hovering a card pops out a tilted pill badge like ‹VIEW MORE› from scale 0, offset 20px down and 10px right, in .2s with back.out(1.7), straightening from 10° to 6°. Other text and the gradient fade to .1 over .3s, and the video slot is on from the start. If released before it is half open, it finishes opening and then closes (.1s before the end)

options.dur: Tag pop-out length (sec), default .2 — .4 for list rows
options.y: Initial vertical shift (px, negative is up), default 20 — list rows use -20
options.hold: If it has not opened this much (fraction), it closes after fully opening, default .5 — 0 closes immediately
options.[data-fx-part=video]: Video that plays from the start on hover (muted loop playsinline)
